children: may retest a support at $3,506 per ounce, as most of the bounce from this level has been reversed.
The reversal signals a continuation of the downtrend. The wave pattern suggests the development of a wave 5, which is supposed to travel below the bottom of the wave 3 around $3,506.

The immediate resistance is at $3,577, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $3,609 to $3,629 range. On the daily chart, a big wave C from $4,694 is unfolding toward its 100% projection level of $3,053, as it has travelled far below its 61.8% level of $3,680.
The downtrend seems to have resumed, as a bounce triggered by the support at $3,542 may have completed, due to the drop during the previous trading session.
